description: Refresh WhatsApp text into an Obsidian vault (data layer, dashboard, group labels, contact notes). Text only, never downloads media, and pulls the recent window the live companion bridge exposes rather than a full multi-year archive. Semi-automatic by design: it drives the live bridge and needs the phone nearby. Triggers: "/whatsapp-sync", "pull whatsapp".
